name: patrick-skills
description: Portable repository, design, UI analysis, mobile performance, Apple system integration, development, and documentation skills for Agent Skills clients.

scripts.check:skills-sh: uv run --locked python scripts/check_skills_sh.py && uv run --locked python scripts/check_skills_sh_security.py
scripts.test: uv run --locked python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.test:repair: uv run --locked python -B -m unittest discover -s skills/repair-photographic-assets/scripts -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:repair && npm run test:installation && npm run validate && npm run validate:claude-plugin && npm run lint:markdown && npm run format:check && npm run skills:list
